## Purpose

To plot summary of multivariate models

```{r data-entry}
library(knitr)
#figures made will go to directory called figures, will make them as both png and pdf files 
opts_chunk$set(fig.path='figures/',
               echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE,dev=c('png','pdf'))
options(scipen = 2, digits = 3)

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

input.file <- 'multivariate_data.csv'
mv.data <- read_tsv(input.file) 
```
# Model Plots

```{r multivariate-plots}
ggplot(mv.data,
       aes(y=Covariates,
       x=beta,
       xmin=beta-se*1.96,
       xmax=beta+se*1.96)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbarh() +
  geom_vline(xintercept=0,lty=2)
```
